title: LedgerRow
description: One transaction as every ledger surface receives it — /api/transactions rows, Today's recent pane, a merchant's history. The Txn TypeScript type on web (webapp/src/api/ledger-row.generated.ts) and mobile (mobile/src/lib/ledger-row.generated.ts) is GENERATED from this file (scripts/gen-ledger-row-types.py); a server test asserts the API emits exactly these keys. Change the shape here, regenerate, and both clients and the server move together.

payee.description: the merchant as the ledger shows it (merchant row name → alias → raw)

merchant_logo.description: Plaid's logo for the merchant, when it has one

category.description: the effective category in DISPLAY form (spaces, never underscores)

counts_as_spend.description: the verdict's own rule: does this row count as household spend

biz_flag.description: Schedule C tag on a household charge

entity.description: the business this row BELONGS to (a business-entity account)

owner.description: household owner (per-txn override else the account's)

recurring_bill.description: the active bill whose matcher counts this row (⟳)

item_summary.description: what a matched store order or receipt contained, by what was bought; null for every other merchant

payment_processor.description: the payment app in front of the merchant (PayPal, Square…)

category_source.description: who decided category_primary: plaid | import | flow | fuel | mcc | rule_user | rule_llm | rule_seed | rule_model | rule

category_why.description: the provenance in words, composed by the server

category_override.description: the override as stored, when any

override_bill_id.description: the bill that stamped the override, when a bill did

override_manual.description: true when a person set the override

override_is_fee.description: true when the row is a companion charge — the fee that rides with override_bill's payment

split.description: a hand split of this charge across categories, in order — stored category keys and cent-exact amounts summing to `amount`; null when the row is not split. `category` stays the whole row's own; the rollups count the parts

splittable.description: true when the split door will take this row — the spend test the rollups use (money out, not a transfer, not a card payment, not on a loan account); clients offer Split and Edit split only when true
